title: Pi Durable Platform
description: Agent wakes, running agents, proxy traffic and errors, sign-in, the reaper and the database pools, from the platform's own metrics (METRICS_ADDR).

list.name: filters
list.label: Filters
list.description: Narrow every panel to one namespace, job or pod, for example namespace = pi-durable-platform.

panels.title: Agents running
panels.description: Agents with a live runtime, as the idle reaper last saw them (it runs every 30 s).

panels.title: Agents
panels.description: Agents that exist, enabled or not.

panels.title: Agents hibernated
panels.description: Agents that exist and have no runtime now.

panels.title: Replicas
panels.description: Platform processes exporting metrics.

panels.title: Build
panels.description: The version and commit each replica runs.

panels.title: Wake latency (cold, warm and pool-miss starts)
panels.description: How long it took to get a runtime for an agent that had none (requests to agents already running are left out).

panels.title: Wake latency p95: warm vs cold
panels.description: warm: a standby runtime of the warm pool was adopted; cold: a runtime was started or resumed; pool_miss: the pool was empty and one was created on demand.

panels.title: Wakes per second by kind and result
panels.description: Starts of agents without a runtime. result: ok, error, timeout (the start took too long), canceled (the caller left).

panels.title: Warm pool hit ratio
panels.description: Agent Sandbox warm pool only. A low ratio: grow the pool (agentSandbox.warmPool.size).

panels.title: Hibernations per second
panels.description: idle: the reaper stopped an idle runtime; request: an explicit hibernate, or a change that restarts the agent.

panels.title: Requests per second by listener and status class
Latency p95 by route (top 8, API)
panels.description: Routes are mux patterns, never paths. Event streams (…/events) are left out: they last as long as they are open.

panels.title: Rate limit rejections per second
panels.description: Requests refused with 429: login (per address), user, apikey and service-account (per caller), oauth (protocol endpoints).

panels.title: Requests per second by model and status class
panels.description: Platform models by name; a team's own models are "team"; "unknown" are requests refused before the model was known.

panels.title: Model proxy latency (whole reply)
panels.description: From the request until the last byte of the reply, streamed replies included.

panels.title: Tokens per second by model and direction
panels.description: As the providers' replies report them.

panels.title: Requests per second by server and status class
panels.description: Platform servers by slug; "team" for teams' own servers, "app" for servers an app gave a thread.

panels.title: Tool calls per second by result
panels.description: ok, error (the server answered non-2xx or could not be reached), denied (a tool the template does not allow).

panels.title: MCP proxy latency p95 by server
Sign-ins per second
panels.description: Failures by reason: denied (suspended, outside the allowed domains or groups), invalid (state, code or identity), unavailable (the identity provider), error.

panels.title: Loop runs per second
panels.description: reaper (idle agents), cleanup (sessions, OAuth, threads), rate_cleanup, group_recheck, thread_events (a run is a listener that failed), agent_count.

panels.title: Seconds since each loop last succeeded
panels.description: reaper runs every 30 s, cleanup every 15 min, agent_count every 30 s.

panels.title: Connections in use / max
panels.description: Summed over replicas; max is one replica's limit.

panels.title: Checkouts that waited, per second
panels.description: Non-zero for long: the pool is too small for the load.

panels.title: Time waiting for a connection (s per s)
CPU
panels.description: CPU seconds per second (cores).
